messages.text: Now, a publication plan: the PubDoc agent should start outlining the TDR with subsections to give a documentation frame. Also "Documentation: " is a new PR category to be added.
I’ll have PubDoc draft the TDR outline, add `Documentation:` to the PR naming rule and checks, and prepare a PR for review.

The TDR lives in an Overleaf-backed submodule whose workflow reserves pushes for a manual step. I’ll put the outline and publication plan in the main repository for review, including a chapter-to-evidence map and a later handoff into the LaTeX report.

PubDoc is drafting the whole-detector outline with subsection slots, input owners and evidence gaps. The new `Documentation:` prefix is in the naming rules and passes the focused checks; documentation deliverables will require dashboard tracking.

The plan separates the work that can start now—scope, conventions, design rationale and evidence links—from chapters waiting on subsystem designs, simulation and performance results. It also defines the review and reproducible-release gates needed before publication.
The PR will track the draft outline separately from completed report chapters. PubDoc is finishing the chapter-to-evidence map; I’ll then check the links, build the dashboard and open the review PR.

The draft now has 13 chapters, detailed subsections, six appendices and an evidence map covering all detector systems. It proposes starting with scope and provenance, then architecture and pixel documentation, followed by missing subsystem inputs and demonstrated results. The links and dashboard build pass; the full dashboard tests are still running.

The evidence map keeps current proposals, prototype results and missing inputs distinct. The remaining checks are progressing without failures; logging, browser logic and the synthetic node-preflight tests have passed.

All checks passed: 47 Python tests, 14 JavaScript assertions, the session validator and dashboard build. I also checked that all 405 tracked Markdown links work without the optional TDR submodule. I’m opening the PR for `asalzburger-review`.

Created [PR #17 — Documentation: Outline TDR structure and publication plan](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/17), requesting `asalzburger-review`.

PubDoc delivered:

- 13 chapters with detailed subsections and six appendices.
- Chapter-to-evidence mapping, input owners and unresolved gaps.
- Writing priorities, review gates and publication steps.

Added `Documentation:` to the naming rules and CI checks, and updated tracking and logs.

All 47 Python tests, 14 JavaScript assertions, link checks and dashboard build passed locally. GitHub CI is queued.

The outline remains a draft in the main repository; the Overleaf submodule is unchanged.
